proposed.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1#1
proposed.text: After winning the election for mayor, Fisk tells Vanessa he knows she had an affair with a man named Adam while he was away.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Vanessa's husband and partner in crime, who learns of her affair with Adam.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Fisk's wife and partner in crime, who had an affair while he was away.

changes.evidence: The pair's stages end at Daredevil S3#13, but their story continues in Born Again. In Born Again S1#1 Fisk tells Vanessa he knows about her affair with Adam (a betrayal). They go to couples therapy over it (S1#2, S1#4), and in S1#8 Fisk shows her the imprisoned Adam and watches her kill him.

proposed.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2#5
proposed.text: Vanessa dies in hospital of the head wound from Fisk's boxing match, after asking him again and again to tell the story of how they met.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Vanessa's husband and partner in crime, at her side when she dies.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Fisk's wife and partner in crime, who dies of a head wound from his boxing match.

changes.evidence: Born Again S2#4: at Fisk's public boxing match, a shard of the glass ornament Fisk shatters hits Vanessa in the head and she collapses. S2#5: in hospital she keeps asking Fisk to tell how they met, her condition gets worse and she dies. A death is a stage, and the pair has none after Daredevil S3#13.

owner_calls.question: What happens on screen between Edwin Jarvis and Tony is only a passing crossing at Camp Lehigh in Avengers: Endgame. Howard asks Jarvis if they have met 'that guy' (Tony, posing as Howard Potts), and Tony and Jarvis never speak. Jarvis looking after young Tony comes from a tie-in comic (Iron Man 2: Public Identity), not from a film or episode. The AI being named after Jarvis is only shown later: VisionQuest#4 'Malware' (Oct 2026) shows Edwin Jarvis's photo among the people Tony based his AIs on. Keep the connection, and if so, how?
options: Drop the connection (N7): no on-screen relationship, only a background crossing at Camp Lehigh
Keep it under the 'huge consequences' exception: cut 'looks after a young Tony' from the Endgame stage, and add a VisionQuest#4 stage for the J.A.R.V.I.S. namesake
owner_calls.evidence: Fandom's Jarvis page cites the childhood care and the AI namesake to the tie-in comic Iron Man 2: Public Identity. Its Camp Lehigh variant page shows the only Endgame exchange is between Howard and Jarvis about Tony. The VisionQuest 'Malware' page lists James D'Arcy as Edwin Jarvis in archive photos, among records of the people behind Tony's AIs.
